events.evidence: U.S. President Obama signs the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 in Denver, Colorado
General Motors and Chrysler inform the U.S. federal government that they will need additional loans of $21.6 billion
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission charges Stanford Financial Group Chairman Allen Stanford with fraud

label.note: Stimulus signing is supportive, but auto bailout need and fraud charge weigh.
